summary.zh: 用 pytest 测试 Temporal 工作流
summary.en: Test Temporal workflows with pytest and time-skipping

description.zh: 覆盖 Temporal 工作流的单元测试、带模拟活动的集成测试和基于生产历史的回放测试，说明时间跳跃、异步 fixture 与本地开发环境搭建。适合为工作流补测试、排查测试不稳定或搭建 CI 流水线时使用。需要本地或容器化的 Temporal 服务。
description.en: Covers unit, integration, and replay tests for Temporal workflows, with time-skipping, async fixtures, mocked activities, and local dev setup. Use it when adding workflow tests or wiring CI. A Temporal server is required.
